ayuda.titulo: camello {version} · local-first job search, driven by your coding agent
ayuda.pie: Typical flow: init → profile check → refresh → pending → judge → shortlist → cv tailor → status. Docs in docs/ (Spanish).
init.descripcion: Step-by-step setup: profile, salary expectation, resume and config.local.json (--yes skips the questions)
init.nada_nuevo: Nothing to create; everything already existed.
init.editar: Edit profile/cv.md and profile/preferencias.md with your real data (no ID number, age or exact address).
profile.descripcion: Validates or initializes the profile (profile/cv.md and preferencias.md)
profile.init_nada: profile/ already had cv.md and preferencias.md; nothing was touched.
profile.import_instrucciones:
Import with the agent (no parsing library):
  1. Read {ruta} in full.
  2. Write a draft master resume at {destino} following the structure of {plantilla}: frontmatter (nombre, ciudad, email, linkedin, github, idiomas), Titular, Resumen, Habilidades, Experiencia with '### Banco de logros' per job (Action + Technology + Impact + Scope, with a number), Educación y certificaciones, Proyectos y comunidad.
  3. Do not invent anything: if an achievement has no number in the original, leave it without one and mark it (verificar).
  4. No ID number, age, marital status or exact address.
  5. Show the result and wait for confirmation before calling it done.
perfil.falta_banco: no experience has '### Banco de logros'
perfil.es_plantilla: it is still the example template (Nombre Apellido / correo@ejemplo.com)
sources.descripcion: Lists or verifies the seed list feeds (sources/empresas.json)
sources.check_resumen: {fraccion} feeds responded · {vacantes} postings published in total.
refresh.descripcion: Ingests every source and detects new, changed and gone postings
refresh.hn_ya_leido: HN: the {mes} thread was already read today; skipping.
refresh.hn_resumen: HN: {fraccion} comments passed the filter · {nuevas} new.
refresh.resumen: {fraccion} sources read · {nuevas} new · {cambiadas} changed · {desaparecidas} gone · {descartadas} dropped by title · {pendientes} pending judgment.
search.descripcion: Keyword search over title, description and company
show.descripcion: Shows a posting in full with its latest judgment and history
show.obsoleto: stale: the posting changed, it will be judged again
pending.descripcion: Postings without a judgment (or with a stale one), as JSON for the agent
pending.resumen: {n} of {total} pending in this batch (max {max} per run, config juicio.max_por_corrida).
pending.instruccion: To judge: read {skill}, run `camello pending --json` and deliver each judgment with `camello judge <id> --from -`.
judge.descripcion: Saves a validated judgment; with a URL, first downloads and stores the posting
judge.sin_objetivo: Missing id or URL: camello judge <id|url> --from <file.json|->
judge.url_siguiente: Now judge it: `camello show {id} --completa` then `camello judge {id} --from -`.
judge.json_invalido: The JSON could not be parsed: {error}
judge.id_no_coincide: The judgment is for '{llego}' but the command asked for '{esperado}'.
shortlist.descripcion: Postings with verdict apply or consider, by score
shortlist.cobertura: {abiertas} of {juzgadas} judged postings are open to you ({activas} active in total).
shortlist.sin_novedad.uno: {n} application with no news for more than {dias} days:
shortlist.sin_novedad.muchos: {n} applications with no news for more than {dias} days:
status.descripcion: Moves a posting through the pipeline or lists by status
stats.descripcion: Summary: postings, judged, verdicts, pipeline and last run
stats.vacantes: Postings: {activas} active of {total} seen · {nuevas7d} new in 7 days.
stats.cobertura: Coverage: {abiertas} of {juzgadas} judged are open to you.
stats.ultima_corrida: Last run: {fecha} · {fraccion} sources · {nuevas} new · {cambiadas} changed · {desaparecidas} gone.
skill.descripcion: Shows where the skill lives and how to install it in your agent
skill.instrucciones: Install: copy the folder {origen} to {destino} (Claude Code) or your agent's equivalent. camello never writes outside the repo and the configured vault.
cv.descripcion: Tailors (tailor), renders (render) or compares (diff) a resume
cv.aviso_imprimir: Print to PDF with Ctrl+P (letter or A4, no browser headers).
cv.tailor_sin_juicio: No judgment yet; tailor from the posting text and the profile.
cv.tailor_instruccion: Agent: apply the rules in {reglas} to {maestra} and write {destino} in language '{idioma}'. Never invent; show the diff and wait for confirmation. Full data with `--json`.
cv.sin_maestra: The master resume does not exist at {ruta}. Run `camello profile init`.
cv.diff_logros: {fraccion} bullets in the tailored resume are backed by the master ({maestra} bullets in the master).
cv.diff_sin_respaldo: {n} bullets WITHOUT clear backing in the master (review, they could be inventions):
cv.diff_todo_respaldado: Zero new claims: every bullet exists in the master.
obsidian.descripcion: Writes Markdown notes to the Obsidian vault (and reads statuses with --pull)
obsidian.sin_vault: Missing obsidian.vault in config.local.json (path to the vault).
obsidian.indice_intro: Notes generated by `camello obsidian sync`. The `## Notas` section of each posting is never overwritten. Change `estado` in the frontmatter and run `camello obsidian sync --pull` to push it to the database.
obsidian.pull_resumen: Pull: {leidas} notes read · {cambiadas} statuses updated in the database.
schedule.descripcion: Installs, removes or checks the scheduled refresh (ingestion only)
schedule.instalado: Refresh scheduled every {cada}. Saved to config.local.json (refresh.cada).
dashboard.descripcion: Generates data/dashboard.html and opens it in the browser
esquema.numero: must be a number >= 0 or null
esquema.lista: must be a list of strings
esquema.aplicar_elegibilidad: 'aplicar' requires eligibility abierta or probable, got '{elegibilidad}'
dashboard.cobertura_cli: {abiertas} of {juzgadas} judged postings are open to you · {shortlist} on the shortlist
dashboard.abriendo: Opening in the default browser (if it does not open, open the path by hand).
dashboard.ultima_corrida: Last run {fecha} · sources read {fraccion} · {nuevas} new, {cambiadas} changed, {desaparecidas} gone
dashboard.sin_corridas: No runs yet. Run camello refresh.
dashboard.cobertura_frase: {abiertas} of {juzgadas} judged postings are open to you ({activas} active in total)
dashboard.h_shortlist_nota: verdict apply or consider, sorted by score
dashboard.filtro_texto: Filter by company, title or summary
dashboard.shortlist_vacio: Nothing on the shortlist yet. Judge the pending postings with camello pending.
dashboard.nuevas_vacio: No new postings in the last 7 days.
dashboard.desaparecidas_vacio: No active application points to a posting that disappeared.
dashboard.pie: Generated by camello on {fecha} · COP rate used: {tasa} per USD · data lives on your machine
hn.sin_hilo: Could not find the "Who is hiring?" thread on Algolia.
pending.duplicados: (+{n} copies of the same posting in other cities; judged together)
judge.propagado: · also applied to {n} copies of the same posting
init.intro: Welcome to camello. Twelve short questions; Enter accepts the value in parentheses. Nothing leaves your machine.
init.p_salario: Minimum salary expectation in USD per month (offers below are flagged, never hidden)
init.p_contrato: Contract type: 1 contractor (Deel, Remote.com, Oyster), 2 employee via EOR, 3 local employee, 4 any
init.p_cv: Path to your resume in PDF or DOCX for the agent to import (Enter to skip)
init.p_vault: Path to your Obsidian vault (Enter to skip)
init.d_zona: UTC-5. Up to 3 hours of difference with the US and Europe is fine.
init.d_roles_no: Junior or mid, support, sales, pre-sales
init.c_contratista: Contractor via Deel, Remote.com or Oyster. Employee via EOR is fine. Local employee only if the salary makes up for it.
init.c_eor: Employee via EOR (Deel, Remote.com, Oyster) or contractor.
init.c_local: Local employee with a contract in my country. Contractor if the salary makes up for it.
init.c_cualquiera: Any arrangement: contractor, EOR or local employee.
init.pref_salario_nota: Offers below are shown flagged; nothing is discarded for salary alone.
init.sobrescribir_pref: profile/preferencias.md already exists. Overwrite it with these answers?
init.paso_cv_importar: 1. Ask your agent: "import my resume from {ruta}". Instructions it will see:
init.paso_cv_editar: 1. Edit {ruta} with your real experience (or run `camello profile import <file.pdf>` with your agent).
init.paso_refresh: 3. `camello refresh` downloads postings (no agent, no tokens). Then your agent judges with `camello pending`.
init.paso_dashboard: 4. `camello dashboard` opens the board whenever you want, also without an agent.
cv.pdf_sin_navegador: Could not find Chrome or Edge to generate the PDF. Open the HTML and print with Ctrl+P, or set CAMELLO_NAVEGADOR to the executable path.
cv.pdf_fallo: The browser could not generate the PDF ({error}). Open the HTML and print with Ctrl+P.
apply.descripcion: Builds the packet so your agent fills the application form (it never submits)
apply.sin_cv: no tailored resume for this company
apply.sugerir_render: PDF missing. Run `camello cv tailor {id}` with your agent, then `camello cv render <file.md>`.
apply.ya_en_estado: This posting is already in status '{estado}'.
apply.instruccion: Agent: follow {skill}. Fill the form in the user's browser (Claude Code: `claude --chrome`) and stop before submitting. Full data with `--json`.
